_comment: Cited waivers for the ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 reference design. Each entry is scoped to one context name: a sheet's Design name for the per-sheet passes, or the merged-board context name the CLI builds (f"{module} (merged)"). The PWR-* entries are per-sheet only - the merged pass needs none of them. The GPIO-001 entries are needed by both, because three of the four strapping pins are genuinely unconnected on the board and rely on the chip's documented reset defaults. Run: python -m src.ecad.rules check examples.esp32_s3_reference --waivers examples/esp32_s3_reference/rule_waivers.json

waivers.reason: VBUS is driven by the USB-C receptacle J1 on the usb sheet
waivers.cited_source: examples/esp32_s3_reference/design.py, 'Cross-sheet net convention': +3V3, GND and VBUS are KiCad global power symbols, which are global across a hierarchy — the rail is driven on another sheet of the same project. The merged-board pass (RuleContext.merged) reports it clean.
waivers.author: stage-g

waivers.reason: +3V3 is driven by the AP2112K-3.3 on the power sheet
waivers.cited_source: examples/esp32_s3_reference/design.py, 'Cross-sheet net convention': +3V3, GND and VBUS are KiCad global power symbols, which are global across a hierarchy — the rail is driven on another sheet of the same project. The merged-board pass (RuleContext.merged) reports it clean.

waivers.reason: the 10 uF at the power entrance is C1, the LDO input capacitor on the power sheet; VBUS is one net across both sheets
waivers.cited_source: examples/esp32_s3_reference/design.py, 'Cross-sheet net convention': +3V3, GND and VBUS are KiCad global power symbols, which are global across a hierarchy — the rail is driven on another sheet of the same project. The merged-board pass (RuleContext.merged) reports it clean. Corroborated by the design's own note: 'HDG Power Supply: at least 10 uF at the main power entrance. The 10 uF is fitted (C1, the LDO input capacitor).'
waivers.author: stage-g

waivers.reason: GPIO3 selects the JTAG signal source and this design deliberately leaves it unconnected, so the eFuse setting decides (USB Serial/JTAG on a blank part, which is how this board is debugged)
waivers.cited_source: Espressif ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 & ESP32-S3-WROOM-1U Datasheet v1.8, Chapter 4 Boot Configurations, Table 4-1 'Default Configuration of Strapping Pins' (p. 13) lists GPIO3 as "Floating", bit value "-", and Sec. 4.4 (p. 15) is explicit: "This pin does not have any internal pull resistors and the strapping value must be controlled by the external circuit that cannot be in a high impedance state." ACCEPTED WITH EYES OPEN: the strap is genuinely undefined here. That is tolerable only because EFUSE_STRAP_JTAG_SEL is 0 on a blank part, which DS Table 4-5 (p. 16) shows makes GPIO3 'Ignored'. Corroborated by Espressif's own ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 V1.1, which runs GPIO3 only to a header. Drive it deliberately if you must force the JTAG source. Matches the waiver=True StrappingDecision for GPIO3 in examples/esp32_s3_reference/design.py.
waivers.author: stage-h

waivers.reason: GPIO45 selects the VDD_SPI voltage and the level this design needs (0 = 3.3 V, for the module's in-package flash) is the chip's own documented reset default
waivers.cited_source: Espressif ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 & ESP32-S3-WROOM-1U Datasheet v1.8, Chapter 4 Boot Configurations, Table 4-1 'Default Configuration of Strapping Pins' (p. 13) lists GPIO45 as "Weak pull-down", bit value 0; the HDG's IO Pin Default Configuration table gives pin 51 GPIO45 "IE, WPD" both at and after reset. The level is held by the internal weak pull-down, not by a resistor on this schematic. Espressif's own ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 V1.1 fits nothing on GPIO45 either. Add an external pull-down if board leakage could lift it. Matches the waiver=True StrappingDecision for GPIO45 in examples/esp32_s3_reference/design.py.
waivers.author: stage-h

waivers.reason: GPIO46 selects boot mode (with GPIO0) and ROM message printing; the 0 this design wants is the chip's own documented reset default
waivers.cited_source: Espressif ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 & ESP32-S3-WROOM-1U Datasheet v1.8, Chapter 4 Boot Configurations, Table 4-1 'Default Configuration of Strapping Pins' (p. 13) lists GPIO46 as "Weak pull-down", bit value 0; the HDG's IO Pin Default Configuration table gives pin 52 GPIO46 "IE, WPD" both at and after reset. DS Table 4-3 needs GPIO46=0 only for Joint Download Boot; SPI Boot accepts any value, so the internal pull-down suffices for the default boot path. Espressif's own ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 V1.1 fits no resistor here — GPIO46 runs only to a header. Add an external pull-down if you need the download path to survive a leaky board. Matches the waiver=True StrappingDecision for GPIO46 in examples/esp32_s3_reference/design.py.
waivers.author: stage-h
